name: docs-gate
description: Reviews, verifies, and reports on Markdown/MDX documentation pages in docs-as-code repos (Docusaurus, Mintlify). Never edits docs on its own.

docs_root.title: Docs root
docs_root.description: Path, relative to the project root, that the PostToolUse lint hook is scoped to. Markdown/MDX edits outside this path are not linted.
